content.title: 2023 Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Atrial Fibrillation
focus: Risk factors and associated heart disease
key_points: Environmental factors, serum biomarkers, and smoking are significant risk factors for atrial fibrillation.
Exercise and aerobic training can reduce the burden of atrial fibrillation.
Obesity management through bariatric surgery may reduce atrial fibrillation burden.
recommendations: Consider environmental and lifestyle risk factors in managing atrial fibrillation.
Promote physical activity and exercise as preventive measures.
Evaluate surgical interventions like bariatric surgery for obese patients.
